## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Landing page hero, Pebblebrook Tea Co., UK audience.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** One problem.
  - "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" is on the policy list.
  - "Free UK delivery on orders over £25" is on the policy list.
  - "Means most boxes ship free" is not on the list. It implies a share of orders (most) that clears the £25 threshold, and nothing in the policy or this chat supports that. Boxes under £25 wouldn't ship free, so the line could mislead.
- **Regulated claims:** This touches prices and offers. The delivery offer is accurate as stated, with the £25 condition shown. The "most boxes ship free" line is the only risk.
- **House style:** The policy gives no voice rules or banned words, so I checked for AI tells only. The copy is plain and has no stock openers, so nothing needs changing there. "Easy to stop and start" is fine.
- **Disclosure:** Not needed. This is the brand's own page, with no ad, sponsorship, affiliate link or AI-content label involved.

**Fixed (suggested edit, since I can't publish):**
- Remove "means most boxes ship free".

> Tea that's easy to stop and start. Subscribers can pause or cancel any time, and delivery is free in the UK on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:**
- If the team has data showing most orders or subscription boxes exceed £25, add it to the policy as a sourced claim and the original line can stay. I'd suggest the edited version above.

**Approver:** The policy doesn't name one, so I need an explicit yes from you on the exact final copy above before it goes live. Nothing has been approved or recorded.
